title: U Mass - Protein Metabolism Study in Mice
author: Jason Kim
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x4ffqtn

steps.title: Prepare Mice
steps.instruction: Prepare mice for the experiment through fasting and catheterization.

substeps.instruction: Fast mice overnight (~15 hours) prior to the start of the experiment.
Place a chronic indwelling catheter 5~6 days prior to the experiment for intravenous infusion (refer to M1023: Surgery-jugular vein cannulation).

steps.title: Set Up Restraint and Infusion
steps.instruction: Secure the mouse and prepare the infusion system.

substeps.instruction: Place the mouse in a rat-size restrainer with its tail tape-tethered at one end.
Expose and flush the intravenous catheter using saline solution.
Connect the catheter to the CMA Microdialysis infusion pump.

steps.title: Collect Basal Plasma Sample
steps.instruction: Collect a basal plasma sample before starting the infusion.

substeps.instruction: Collect 20 µl of plasma (basal-0 min) to measure basal glucose and insulin levels.

steps.title: Induce and Maintain Hyperglycemia
steps.instruction: Infuse dextrose to reach and maintain target glucose levels.

substeps.instruction: Start infusion of 20% dextrose to quickly reach a target hyperglycemia (~300 mg/dl glucose level).
Maintain hyperglycemia by adjusting glucose infusion rates.

steps.title: Collect Timed Plasma Samples
steps.instruction: Collect plasma samples at specified intervals to monitor glucose and insulin.

substeps.instruction: Collect 10 µl plasma samples at 10, 20, 30, 45, 60, 90, and 120 min to measure glucose levels.
Adjust glucose infusion rates based on instantaneous glucose levels to maintain target hyperglycemia.
Collect additional 10 µl plasma samples at 10, 20, 30, 45, 60, 90, and 120 min to measure insulin concentrations.

steps.title: Terminate Experiment
steps.instruction: Euthanize the mice and collect tissues if necessary.

substeps.instruction: Euthanize mice at the end of the experiment.
Collect the pancreas for further studies if required.

steps.title: Perform Data Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze plasma concentrations and calculate insulin secretion metrics.

substeps.instruction: Plot plasma insulin concentrations during the 120-min hyperglycemic clamp experiment.
Calculate the area-under-curve (AUC) of insulin levels to correlate with insulin secretion and pancreatic β-cell function.
Optionally collect additional plasma samples to measure serum c-peptide concentrations.
